    StartersNut, apricot and chocolate trail mixRoasted almonds and cashews, dried apricot and chocolate chipsHow to make it150g almonds150g cashews150g dried apricots100g dark chocolate chipsRoast the almonds and cashews at 180°C and cool.Chop the apricots, then mix with the nuts and chocolate chips.Portion into small paper bags.Red Guardian's picklesCucumber spears pickled in vinegar with dill and garlicHow to make it4 Lebanese cucumbers1 bunch dill3 garlic cloves250ml white vinegar250ml water1 tbsp caster sugar1 tbsp salt1 loaf rye bread100g salted butterCut the cucumbers into spears and slice the garlic.Pack the cucumbers, dill and garlic into a jar.Heat the vinegar, water, sugar and salt until dissolved, then pour over.Chill overnight.Serve with rye bread and butter.Vault escape smash burger slidersThe team breaking out of the vaultHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef patties smashed thin on a hot grill, cheddar melted on, tucked into slider buns with pickles and tomato sauce.Roll 500g beef mince into 12 balls.Smash each flat onto a smoking hot greased flat plate, season and cook 2 minutes until a dark crust forms.Flip, top with a quarter slice of cheddar and cook 1 minute more.Toast 12 slider buns cut side down.Mix 3 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp mustard.Build with sauce, a patty, sliced dill pickle and a few thin onion rings.MainsBeef and mushroom stroganoffSliced rump, mushrooms, paprika and sour cream sauceHow to make it600g beef rump, thinly sliced300g mushrooms1 brown onion1 tbsp sweet paprika300ml sour cream400g egg noodles2 tbsp butter2 tbsp vegetable oilSlice the onion and mushrooms.Sear the beef in the oil in batches and set aside.Cook the onion and mushrooms until golden and stir in the paprika.Stir in the sour cream and return the beef, warming through without boiling.Cook the noodles, toss in butter and serve the stroganoff over the top.New York chicken shawarma wrapsThe team in New YorkHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic and shawarma spices, charred and sliced into flatbread with lettuce, tomato, pickles and garlic sauce.Marinate 800g chicken thigh for 1 hour with the juice of 1 lemon, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cinnamon and 3 tbsp olive oil.Grill on high heat 5 minutes a side until charred, rest and slice.Mix 150g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove, lemon juice and salt for the sauce.Warm 4 large flatbreads and fill with lettuce, tomato, pickled turnip or dill pickles, chicken and sauce.Roll tightly in foil.SweetsBob's
